snippets.en: After you are organized, you shall be called the United Order of the Stake of Zion, the City of Kirtland. And your brethren, after they are organized, shall be called the United Order of the City of Zion.
snippets.tr: Depois de estardes organizados, sereis chamados de Ordem Unida da Estaca de Sião, da cidade de Kirtland. E vossos irmãos, depois de se organizarem, serão chamados de Ordem Unida da Cidade de Sião.

snippets.en: After you are organized, you shall be called the United Order of the Stake of Zion, the City of Kirtland. And your brethren, after they are organized, shall be called the United Order of the City of Zion.
snippets.tr: Después de organizaros, os llamaréis la Orden Unida de la Estaca de Sion, de la ciudad de Kirtland; y vuestros hermanos, después de organizarse, se llamarán la Orden Unida de la Ciudad de Sion.
